Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nitin - 32 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 59 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Kavita - 33 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Rajesh - 31 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The ghat - Day

[Nitin stands on the ghat. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nitin drowns in the river.]

Meenakshi: "No… this cannot be!"
